The short soft-round construction, evident middle, broad torso, and gentle limb contours remain coherent with the summon without athletic, ripped, or bodybuilder drift.

The black, white, and muted-lilac split-streak short textured crop, front curl mass, asymmetrical part, and close-shaved side remain source-faithful.

The lilac-smoke fitted vest over the soft repaired shirt, high-waist mended trousers, broad folded collar, divided waist hem, flexible boots, nose stud, and source waist ornament are preserved, but four distinct metal hair rings are visible instead of the exact required and source-bound count of three.

At original resolution, the topmost-hair-to-chin unit measures approximately 35-36 percent of the topmost-hair-to-lowest-sole standing height, unambiguously inside the required 32-36 percent range and approximately 2.8 heads tall.
Exactly one complete subject is present; the entire head and hair, both hands, and both boots are fully visible inside generous safe margins.
The planted three-quarter ready-idle, separated arms, closed empty hands, compact silhouette, high collar, vest mass, and split crop read cleanly at combat-icon scale without a weapon.

The repaired everyday cloth, worn boots, modest personal hardware, and parchment wash remain grounded and mortal; no weapon, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, elite armor, floating, frame, star, UI, text, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect is present.
